requirements.text: The intensity of the FEC controls supported by the model is commensurate with the risks identified for customers, products, transactions, delivery channels and geographies.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: The SIRA is performed at least annually and on material change, identifying inherent risks, control effectiveness and residual risks against risk appetite.
requirements.level_reason: Institution-wide risk assessment obligation; evidenced in the Systematic Integrity Risk Analysis report, not in model documentation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal provision authored; Wwft Art. 2b checked; AMLR Art. 10 (business-wide risk assessment) numbering to be confirmed.

requirements.text: Each material risk scenario identified in the SIRA is mapped to one or more detection controls, and coverage gaps are recorded with remediation plans.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: CDD comprises identification and verification of the customer, identification and verification of the beneficial owner, assessment of purpose and intended nature of the relationship, and PEP determination.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the customer due diligence process; evidenced in KYC procedures and customer files, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0); Wwft article reference paraphrased, not quoted.

requirements.text: Every customer is assigned a Customer Risk Rating at onboarding using the approved CRR methodology, which considers at least customer, product and service, delivery channel and geographic risk factors.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Enhanced due diligence, including source of funds and wealth and senior management approval, is applied to High-risk customers, PEPs and customers linked to high-risk third countries.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the customer due diligence process; evidenced in EDD procedures and customer files, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0); Wwft article reference paraphrased, not quoted.

requirements.text: Customer information is periodically reviewed at least annually for High, every three years for Medium and every five years for Low-risk customers, and upon event-driven triggers.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the periodic customer review process; evidenced in KYC review records, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Manual overrides of a model-assigned CRR are justified, approved by a person independent of the relationship manager and monitored for frequency and direction.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Transactions and customer behaviour are monitored throughout the business relationship to detect transactions unusual in relation to the customer's profile and risk.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0); Wwft article reference paraphrased, not quoted.

requirements.text: Transaction monitoring coverage of customers, accounts, products and payment channels is documented in a coverage matrix linking SIRA risks to scenarios, with uncovered populations justified.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Scenarios, thresholds and alert-prioritisation models are designed, calibrated, tested and periodically tuned in accordance with FEC-STD-600.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Level-1 review of each alert is completed within 30 calendar days of generation and documented so that the decision can be reconstructed.
requirements.level_reason: Operational obligation of the alert handling process; evidenced in case management records, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Alerts are closed automatically by a model only where the auto-closure logic is validated, approved by the Financial Economic Crime Committee and subject to sample-based quality assurance.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Customers, beneficial owners, representatives and counterparties are screened against at least the EU, Dutch national and UN sanctions lists at onboarding, on list updates and on customer data changes.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Screening configurations, including fuzzy-matching algorithms, thresholds and list selections, are tested at least annually for effectiveness and efficiency.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: Unusual transactions are reported to FIU-Nederland without delay, with an internal target of fourteen calendar days after the conclusion that a transaction is unusual.
requirements.level_reason: Reporting obligation of the institution towards FIU-Nederland; evidenced in unusual transaction reports and case records, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0); Wwft article reference paraphrased, not quoted.

requirements.text: Fraud transaction monitoring takes into account at least compromised authentication elements, transaction amount, known fraud scenarios, signs of malware infection and abnormal device or software use.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud prevention and detection models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0); PSD2 RTS article reference checked.

requirements.text: Where the transaction-risk-analysis exemption is applied, fraud rates are monitored quarterly per payment type and use of the exemption ceases when reference fraud rates are exceeded.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of the institution under the PSD2 exemption regime; evidenced in quarterly fraud-rate reporting, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud prevention and detection models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0); PSD2 RTS article reference checked.

requirements.text: Customer-facing effects of fraud blocking are covered by documented customer contact and payment release procedures.
requirements.level_reason: Operational customer-handling obligation; evidenced in customer contact and payment release procedures, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud prevention and detection models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).

requirements.text: CDD records, transaction records, alert investigations and reports are retained for five years after the end of the relationship or occasional transaction.
requirements.level_reason: Institution-wide record-keeping obligation; evidenced in the Bank's records retention schedule and archives, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering and sanctions models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal provision authored; Wwft Art. 33 retention period to be confirmed against the consolidated Wwft.

requirements.text: Data feeds used for CRR, transaction monitoring, screening and fraud detection are reconciled with source systems at least monthly and data gaps are reported to Financial Crime Compliance.
requirements.verification_note: Internal policy text authored for the library (FEC-POL-001 v6.0).
